انثنيت (form VII)
# اِنْثَنَيْتُ (inṯanaytu) /in.θa.naj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْثَنَى (inṯanā)
# اِنْثَنَيْتَ (inṯanayta) /in.θa.naj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْثَنَى (inṯanā)
# اِنْثَنَيْتِ (inṯanayti) /in.θa.naj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْثَنَى (inṯanā)
